ei.title: 3번: The Difference Between Law and Ethics
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: "Legal" and "ethical" are not the same thing. Although they seem similar, what is "legal" is not always "ethical," and what is "ethical" is not always "legal." A society's ethics are passed down from one generation to the next, while laws are created by governments. Laws can be changed based on the decisions of people in power, rather than by the beliefs of society as a whole. Another important difference between ethics and laws is how they are enforced. There are no special authorities who make us follow ethics — they are simply something we learn from the people around us. Laws, on the other hand, are enforced by the government, so people know they must obey them. There are many unethical actions, like charging too much for products or spreading false rumors, that are not illegal. However, if you break a law, you will face direct consequences from the government.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

✅ ③ changing: 'Laws can be changing based on' — can be+p.p. 수동태 자리에 현재분사(-ing) 불가. can be changed가 정답 → 오류

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① whom → who 오류(주격 관계대명사 자리에 목적격 불가), ② what=~하는 것(관계대명사 정상), ③ rather=오히려(부사 정상), ④ them=그것들(목적격 대명사 정상)
det.analysis:
✅ ① whom: 'There are no special authorities whom make us follow ethics' — make의 주어 역할이므로 주격 who 필요. 목적격 whom 불가 → 오류
❌ ② what: 'what is legal is not always ethical' — 선행사 포함 관계대명사 정상
❌ ③ rather: 'rather than by the beliefs' — 부사 정상
❌ ④ them: 'they must obey them' — 동사 obey의 목적어 정상
det.tip: 관계대명사: 뒤에 동사(make)가 바로 오면 주격 who. 목적격 whom은 주어+동사 앞에서만

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② passed=전해진(맥락 적절), ② identical → similar (같아 보이지만 같지 않다는 문맥에서 '동일한'은 부적절), ③ enforced=시행되는(맥락 적절), ④ direct=직접적인(맥락 적절)
det.analysis:
❌ ① passed: 'ethics are passed down from one generation' — 윤리가 세대에서 세대로 전해진다는 맥락 적절
✅ ② identical: 'Although they seem identical' — 첫 문장에서 'not the same thing'이라고 했고, 비슷해 보이지만 같지 않다는 흐름. identical(동일한)은 'not the same'과 모순 → 부적절. 원문 similar(비슷한)가 적절
❌ ③ enforced: 'Laws are enforced by the government' — 법은 정부에 의해 시행된다는 맥락 적절
❌ ④ direct: 'you will face direct consequences' — 직접적인 결과를 직면한다는 맥락 적절
det.tip: seem similar(비슷해 보이다) vs seem identical(동일해 보이다) — 앞뒤 문맥 'not the same'과의 일치 확인

A society's ethics are passed down from one generation to the next, while laws are created by governments. Laws can be changed based on the decisions of people in power, rather than by the beliefs of society as a ②<u>whole</u>. Another important difference between ethics and laws is how they are enforced. There are no special authorities who make us ④<u>ignore</u> ethics — they are simply something we learn from the people around us. Laws, on the other hand, are enforced by the government, so people know they must obey them. There are many ③<u>unethical</u> actions, like charging too much for products or spreading false rumors, that are not ①<u>illegal</u>. However, if you break a law, you will face direct consequences from the government.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ whole=전체(맥락 적절), ② unethical=비윤리적인(맥락 적절), ③ ignore → follow (윤리를 따르게 하는 권위가 없다는 문맥에서 '무시하게 하는 권위가 없다'는 의미 역전), ④ illegal=불법적인(맥락 적절)
det.analysis:
❌ ① whole: 'society as a whole' — 사회 전체라는 맥락 적절
❌ ② unethical: 'There are many unethical actions' — 비윤리적인 행동 맥락 적절
✅ ④ ignore: 'There are no special authorities who make us ignore ethics' — 원문은 '윤리를 따르게 하는 특별한 권위는 없다'는 뜻. ignore(무시하다)로 바꾸면 '윤리를 무시하게 하는 권위가 없다'가 되어 문맥 역전 → 부적절
❌ ③ illegal: 'that are not illegal' — 불법이 아닌 맥락 적절
det.tip: follow ethics(윤리를 따르다) vs ignore ethics(윤리를 무시하다) — 해당 문장의 핵심은 윤리를 따르도록 강제하는 권위가 없다는 것

questions.passage: "Legal" and "ethical" are not the same thing. Although they seem similar, what is "legal" is not always "ethical," and what is "ethical" is not always "legal." A society's ethics are passed down from one generation to the next, while laws are created by governments. Laws can be changed based on the decisions of people in power, rather than by the beliefs of society as a whole. Another important difference between ethics and laws is how they are enforced. There are no special authorities who make us follow ethics — they are simply something we learn from the people around us. Laws, on the other hand, are enforced by the government, so people know they must obey them. There are many unethical actions, like charging too much for products or spreading false rumors, that are not illegal. However, if you break a law, you will face direct consequences from the government.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③: 글의 핵심 — legal과 ethical이 같지 않으며, 기원(세대 전승 vs 정부 제정), 변경 주체(사회 vs 권력자), 시행 방식(자발 vs 강제), 범위(unethical≠illegal) 등 실질적 차이를 구체적으로 설명
❌ ①: 처벌이나 법적 장치 강화는 본문 주장이 아님

❌ ④: 법 집행이 윤리 교육에 미치는 영향은 언급 없음
det.tip: 핵심 구분: 기원(ethics=세대전승, laws=정부), 시행(자발 vs 강제), 범위(unethical≠illegal)
